claims.statement: The project package scripts provide development, production build/start, lint, test, Payload CLI, type generation, and import-map generation commands.

Local Compose exposes the application on port 3000 and PostgreSQL on port 5432, bind-mounts the repository into the application service, and uses named volumes for dependencies, Next cache, and PostgreSQL data.
Payload configuration declares the application collections, Header and Footer globals, PostgreSQL connection, and generated type output path.
The environment example defines database, Payload signing, server URL, cron, preview, and optional Amazon tag configuration values.
